# Pitlane 0.5.6

Account settings, provider preferences, and subscription management in one place.

- Open **Settings** from the account menu to access **Account**, **Preferences**, **Billing**, and **Updates**. The menu now contains Settings and Log out.
- Save your account name and avatar, change your password, and scroll through the Account panel.
- Manage Codex, Claude, Gemini, OpenRouter, and Grok connections in Preferences. Pending connections retain their Reopen and Cancel controls after navigating away and back.
- Add OpenRouter model support, with an optional free-only setting that rejects models without confirmed zero pricing and does not fall back to paid models.
- Add Grok Build integration for personal accounts through the official Windows runtime and authorization flow.
- Move YOLO and automatic task-model selection into Preferences. Both default to enabled for new settings; previously saved choices remain respected. Planning questions and cancellation remain interactive.
- View recurring subscription details and the next billing date when available, or open the billing portal to manage a subscription and payment method.
- Simplify the mission composer by removing the Connection status disclosure and the previous YOLO/model-selection controls. Existing model availability checks remain active.

Windows x64. Real Grok/OpenRouter execution and authenticated Claude/Gemini execution remain unverified. Provider setup and subscription-dependent behavior require the corresponding account access. Clean-Windows installation and an update through the installed updater are outside this validation.
